description: Local Windows reputation and explanation data. Not a blacklist/whitelist for automated deletion.

entries.name: System
entries.plain_english_description: Kernel system process placeholder for NT kernel work — not a normal app you can end safely.
entries.warning_if_changed: Stopping this process is not supported; the machine would halt or bugcheck.
entries.recommended_action: Never terminate.

entries.name: smss.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Session Manager Subsystem — starts user sessions during boot.
entries.warning_if_changed: Do not end; required for Windows startup.
entries.recommended_action: Leave running.

entries.name: csrss.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Critical user-mode portion of the Windows subsystem.
entries.warning_if_changed: Ending csrss can crash the session or BSOD.
entries.recommended_action: Never terminate.

entries.name: wininit.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Initializes key Windows subsystems at logon.
entries.warning_if_changed: Required for a stable desktop session.
entries.recommended_action: Never terminate.

entries.name: services.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Service Control Manager — starts and manages Windows services.
entries.warning_if_changed: Stopping services.exe breaks nearly all background services.
entries.recommended_action: Never terminate.

entries.name: lsass.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Handles authentication, security policy, and credential-related operations.
entries.warning_if_changed: Terminating forces logoff or reboot; mimics malware behaviour.
entries.recommended_action: Never terminate.

entries.name: svchost.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Hosts shared service DLLs — many instances are normal; each groups related services.
entries.warning_if_changed: Killing random svchost can break audio, network, or updates.
entries.recommended_action: Identify hosted services (Task Manager) before changing services.

entries.name: RuntimeBroker.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Mediates permissions for UWP / Microsoft Store style apps.
entries.warning_if_changed: Ending may freeze Store or UWP apps until restart.
entries.recommended_action: Usually leave; investigate if CPU usage is sustained.

entries.name: explorer.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Desktop, taskbar, and File Explorer shell.
entries.warning_if_changed: Ending removes desktop UI; can restart via Task Manager.
entries.recommended_action: Do not kill during normal use; restart shell only when troubleshooting.

entries.name: dwm.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Composites the desktop and visual effects / transparency.
entries.warning_if_changed: Stopping breaks Aero/visual stack; may recover automatically.
entries.recommended_action: Never terminate during gaming troubleshooting without a plan.

entries.name: MsMpEng.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Microsoft Defender real-time protection scanning engine.
entries.warning_if_changed: Disabling reduces malware protection; add exclusions instead where appropriate.
entries.recommended_action: Keep enabled; tune exclusions for trusted games folders if needed.

entries.name: SecurityHealthService.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Windows Security (Settings app) health and reporting.
entries.warning_if_changed: Disabling security health is not a performance win.
entries.recommended_action: Leave enabled.

entries.name: NisSrv.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Microsoft Defender network inspection service process.
entries.warning_if_changed: Part of Defender; do not disable casually.
entries.recommended_action: Leave enabled.

entries.name: windefend
entries.plain_english_description: Microsoft Defender antivirus service.
entries.warning_if_changed: Stopping exposes the system to malware.
entries.recommended_action: Keep running.

entries.name: wscsvc
entries.plain_english_description: Security Center monitors AV / firewall status for the Security dashboard.
entries.warning_if_changed: May hide security warnings in Settings.
entries.recommended_action: Leave enabled.

entries.name: NVDisplay.Container.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Part of NVIDIA driver stack for display management and telemetry hooks.
entries.warning_if_changed: Can destabilize display output or GeForce features.
entries.recommended_action: Update drivers from nvidia.com instead of killing.

entries.name: nvcontainer.exe
entries.plain_english_description: NVIDIA backend container for driver services and GeForce Experience integration.
entries.warning_if_changed: May break overlays, ShadowPlay, or driver utilities.
entries.recommended_action: Prefer driver/settings changes over force-killing.

entries.name: nvvsvc.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Legacy NVIDIA driver helper on some systems.
entries.warning_if_changed: GPU stack dependency.
entries.recommended_action: Update or repair GPU driver.

entries.name: atieclxx.exe
entries.plain_english_description: AMD external events utility for Radeon software.
entries.warning_if_changed: May affect Radeon Settings and power features.
entries.recommended_action: Use AMD driver installer to repair.

entries.name: amdow.exe
entries.plain_english_description: AMD driver/on-device worker component.
entries.warning_if_changed: Part of AMD graphics stack.
entries.recommended_action: Do not terminate; update GPU drivers.

entries.name: igfxEM.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Intel Graphics Command Center / display enhancement module.
entries.warning_if_changed: May reset color/power display features until reboot.
entries.recommended_action: Update Intel graphics driver from manufacturer.

entries.name: audiodg.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Isolates audio DSP processing for drivers and effects.
entries.warning_if_changed: Killing stops system audio until restart.
entries.recommended_action: Troubleshoot drivers; avoid killing during streams.

entries.name: RtkAudUService64.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Realtek HD Audio universal service for onboard audio.
entries.warning_if_changed: May silence or distort audio until service restarts.
entries.recommended_action: Update OEM/Realtek audio driver.

entries.name: steam.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Main Steam client — library, downloads, and game launches.
entries.warning_if_changed: Closing exits Steam overlay and may interrupt downloads.
entries.recommended_action: Close from Steam UI; avoid Task Manager unless frozen.

entries.name: SteamService.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Steam client service — installs/updates and DRM hooks for some titles.
entries.warning_if_changed: Can break Steam until restart.
entries.recommended_action: Restart Steam; repair installation if stuck.

entries.name: steamwebhelper.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Chromium-based Steam store/library UI renderer.
entries.warning_if_changed: Multiple instances are normal; killing may glitch UI.
entries.recommended_action: Prefer closing Steam; Performance mode may suspend if explicitly allowed by policy.

entries.name: EpicGamesLauncher.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Epic Games Store launcher.
entries.warning_if_changed: Games relying on launcher may not start until reopened.
entries.recommended_action: Exit when not needed; optional startup disable.

entries.name: EpicWebHelper.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Embedded browser helper for Epic launcher.
entries.warning_if_changed: Launcher UI may glitch if killed in isolation.
entries.recommended_action: Close Epic launcher cleanly.

entries.name: Battle.net.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Battle.net desktop app for Blizzard titles.
entries.warning_if_changed: Games may require launcher for auth/patches.
entries.recommended_action: Exit when idle.

entries.name: RiotClientServices.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Riot client background services for League/VALORANT etc.
entries.warning_if_changed: Anticheat may require client; closing wrong subprocess can trigger kick.
entries.recommended_action: Exit via Riot client; do not kill Vanguard-related without research.

entries.name: EADesktop.exe
entries.plain_english_description: EA desktop client for EA Play and games.
entries.warning_if_changed: Some EA titles need client for online features.
entries.recommended_action: Exit when not gaming.

entries.name: upc.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Ubisoft Connect launcher.
entries.warning_if_changed: Ubisoft single-player may still want Connect for cloud saves.
entries.recommended_action: Exit from tray when idle.

entries.name: Discord.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Discord voice, chat, and overlay client.
entries.warning_if_changed: Overlay hooks can affect fullscreen exclusive mode.
entries.recommended_action: Close when not needed; review startup if boot is slow.

entries.name: Spotify.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Spotify desktop music client.
entries.warning_if_changed: Background audio continues if minimized.
entries.recommended_action: Exit or disable autostart if not used.

entries.name: OneDrive.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Syncs OneDrive files to your PC.
entries.warning_if_changed: Pausing sync stops file updates until resumed.
entries.recommended_action: Pause syncing during gaming if disk busy.

entries.name: GoogleDriveFS.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Google Drive file stream / mirror client.
entries.warning_if_changed: Files may be unavailable offline until restarted.
entries.recommended_action: Exit during competitive play if IO is an issue.

entries.name: chrome.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Chrome main browser process.
entries.warning_if_changed: Many tabs = large RAM; killing loses unsaved form data.
entries.recommended_action: Close unused profiles/tabs; never auto-kill without user intent.

entries.name: crashpad_handler.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Crash reporting helper spawned by Chrome, Edge, and other Chromium apps — typically short-lived.
entries.warning_if_changed: Killing may suppress crash telemetry only; do not confuse with unrelated binaries of the same name.
entries.recommended_action: Leave alone unless misidentified; verify full path.

entries.name: msedge.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Edge main browser process.
entries.warning_if_changed: Edge is deeply integrated with WebView2 apps.
entries.recommended_action: Close from browser UI when possible.

entries.name: firefox.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Firefox main process.
entries.recommended_action: Quit Firefox normally.

entries.name: GoogleUpdate.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Background updater for Google software (Chrome, Earth, etc.).
entries.warning_if_changed: Delaying updates increases security risk over time.
entries.recommended_action: Let finish or schedule off-hours.

entries.name: MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Edge and WebView2 component updater.
entries.warning_if_changed: Needed for security updates to Edge runtime.
entries.recommended_action: Allow periodic updates.

entries.name: EasyAntiCheat.exe
entries.plain_english_description: Easy Anti-Cheat for protected multiplayer titles.
entries.warning_if_changed: Removing or killing = game kick/ban risk.
entries.recommended_action: Never tamper; follow publisher support.

entries.name: BEService.exe
entries.plain_english_description: BattlEye anticheat service process.
entries.warning_if_changed: Games with BattlEye will refuse to run.
entries.recommended_action: Never kill or uninstall except via game uninstall.

entries.name: bits
entries.plain_english_description: Transfers files in the background for Windows Update and other components.
entries.warning_if_changed: Disabling can break updates and Microsoft Store downloads.
entries.recommended_action: Leave on Manual/Automatic per default Windows policy.

entries.name: wuauserv
entries.plain_english_description: Windows Update service for patches and feature updates.
entries.warning_if_changed: Security patches may not apply.
entries.recommended_action: Keep enabled; schedule active hours if reboots interrupt play.

entries.name: RpcSs
entries.plain_english_description: RPC endpoint mapper — required by countless OS and app components.
entries.warning_if_changed: Disabling breaks most Windows functionality.
entries.recommended_action: Never disable.

entries.name: OneDrive
entries.plain_english_description: Starts Microsoft OneDrive at logon to begin file sync.
entries.warning_if_changed: Files may not sync until launched manually.
entries.recommended_action: Disable from Startup apps if you do not use OneDrive.

entries.name: Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\Scheduled Start
entries.plain_english_description: Periodic Windows Update scan/start (exact path varies by OS).
entries.warning_if_changed: Blocking update tasks can delay security fixes.
entries.recommended_action: Use Active Hours instead of disabling tasks.
